local m=emu.memType.nesInternalRam
local room=emu.read(0x78,m)+256*emu.read(0x79,m)
local st=emu.read(0x300,m)
local sc=emu.read(0x60,m)+256*emu.read(0x61,m)
local x=emu.read(0x4e0,m)
local y=emu.read(0x4f0,m)
local keys={}
if frame<260 then
 keys.left=frame>=20 and frame<155
 keys.a=(frame>=20 and frame<55)or(frame>=85 and frame<120)
elseif room==0x8d9d then
 if sc<768 then cameraReady=true end
 local wx=x+(cameraReady and sc or 0)
 local function tile(xx,yy)
  xx=(xx+(cameraReady and 0 or 256))%512;yy=yy%240
  return emu.read(0x2000+math.floor(xx/256)*0x400+math.floor(yy/8)*32+math.floor(xx%256/8),emu.memType.nesPpuMemory)
 end
 local function solid(t)return (t>=0x2e and t<=0x33)or(t>=0x47 and t<=0x4a)or(t>=0x75 and t<=0x80)end
 if not jumpAt then jumpAt=260 end
 local ahead=solid(tile(wx+8,y+1));local wall=solid(tile(wx+40,y-12))
 if st<2 and frame-jumpAt>65 and (not ahead or wall) then jumpAt=frame end
 local age=frame-jumpAt
 keys.right=age>=13
 keys.a=age>=3 and age<(wx>=280 and 15 or 33)
 if wx>=280 then keys.right=age>=4 end
 if st<2 and not ahead and age>30 and age<=65 then keys.right=false end
 keys.b=false
end
emu.setInput(keys,0)
emu.setInput({left=frame>=20 and frame<155,a=(frame>=20 and frame<55)or(frame>=85 and frame<120),select=frame>=320 and frame<324,b=frame>=350 and frame<354},0)

emu.setInput({left=frame>=20 and frame<155,a=(frame>=20 and frame<55)or(frame>=85 and frame<120),start=(frame>=400 and frame<404)or(frame>=540 and frame<544),right=frame>=440 and frame<444,left=frame>=480 and frame<484},0)

 end
